title: An Imported work order's Reassign lead technician is disabled with its tooltip
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 10 minutes.
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011).
  • [User-A] = you: an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch the Admin quick-login user, shown as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit.
  • Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide. Narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher.
  • One location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); everything below is created in this location.
  • An Imported work order exists at this location ([WO-1]). Imported work orders come only from an invoice import; to make one: Settings > Invoices (in the IMPORTS group): click Download Template, fill one row in the template (keep its heading row; the columns marked * are required; Shop Location = this location's name, a customer name, an Invoice Number such as ZZIMP-1001, Invoice Date as month/day/year e.g. 10/01/2026, Item Labor, a Line Title, Qty 1, Rate 100, Total 100, Tax Amount 5), save it as a .csv file, click Select CSV File, pick the file and click Import Invoices; the message reads "All invoices have been imported successfully." The imported work order's number is the Invoice Number you typed, and it is listed only when Status > Imported is ticked.
  • The number is an example; what must hold: at least one work order with status Imported at this location.

Setup

  1. Sign in as an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders).
  2. Use one location for the whole case: it is shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location.
  3. An Imported work order exists at this location. Imported work orders come from a data import; to find one, open Work Orders in List, click the All tab, open Status and tick Imported (e.g. "S2-17578"). If there is none, mark the case Blocked with 'no Imported work order on this site'.
  4. In List, note the Imported work order's number and record it as [WO-1] (e.g. "S2-17578").
  5. Check the setup worked: in List with Status = Imported, [WO-1] shows with status Imported. If no Imported work order shows, mark the case Blocked with 'no Imported work order on this site'. Then open Status and click Clear selection.
custom_steps:
1. Pick Board View in the display switcher and search for [WO-1].
  2. If the card is shown, hover it, click More actions and hover the Reassign lead technician action.
  3. Read the tooltip shown next to the Reassign lead technician action.
  4. Repeat steps 1 to 3 in Tech View.
  5. If the Imported work order cannot be shown in Board View or Tech View at all (for example the Status filter's Imported option is disabled there), write down exactly what you see.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Reassign lead technician is disabled on the Imported work order and its tooltip reads exactly: The lead technician can’t be changed on an imported work order.
  • If an Imported work order never appears in Board View or Tech View, so the action cannot be reached, mark the case Blocked with 'Imported work orders are not shown in Tech View or Board View'. That is an open product question, not a failure.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10047 (Story 4, Reassign or unassign the lead technician); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S4-N9, read 8 Oct 2026. Review Decisions DR-37 (Chris Ward, 29 Sep 2026). Tech plan §3.26 / PO answer 24 Sep 2026: Imported is excluded from the board displays. Design export of 8 Oct 2026 (Claude Design project 787fef1a, Work Orders.dc.html): Imported cards show "Imported · review before assigning". Source-verified 8 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-N9: “The disabled Reassign lead technician action on an Imported work order shows this tooltip: “The lead technician can’t be changed on an imported work order.””
  • Tech plan §3.26: “Imported is excluded from the board displays (follow-up A3). While the Imported status chip is selected, Tech View and Board View are disabled in the switcher with a tooltip; while in Tech View or Board View, the Imported option in the Status filter is disabled.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026.
